briefs.claim_en: Two crocodiles were spotted yesterday evening in Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysuru.
briefs.brief_en: While the claim states two crocodiles were spotted on October 8, 2026, the provided evidence does not confirm this specific event. However, multiple sources indicate that crocodiles are frequently sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake. A "huge crocodile" was photographed there on December 1, 2024, according to starofmysore.com. Another report from January 28, 2026, also from starofmysore.com, mentions a recent crocodile sighting, with an environmentalist claiming to have seen it four times. Inshorts.com reported in September 2026 that visitors were warned about crocodile attacks at the lake, suggesting their continued presence.
gaps_en: No evidence directly confirms the sighting of two crocodiles on October 8, 2026.
The exact number of crocodiles and the specific date of the claimed sighting are not corroborated by the provided sources.
